question: Does the blind cloud-data omega-grid + local-window surrogate-MSE + LM polish pipeline land >=1 polished candidate in Band A or B on seed 28 with no truth-cluster injection?
hypothesis: The s059j architecture, run blind, lands at least one polished candidate in Band A or B on seed 28.
narrative_md: Blind single-seed pilot (no truth-cluster injection) on seed 28: Band A/B yield 0/20 -- GO/NO-GO gate FAILS (wall 18.2 min). Post-hoc decoupled W-sweep diagnoses the bottleneck as omega-DIRECTION grid spacing: at truth-EXACT rho=0.33-0.51 (surface is correct/sharp), but the N_DIRS=200 Fibonacci 5.33deg quantization alone pushes the closest cell to rho=41.5 (Band D). q_a noise is benign (wider W helps); omega-dir noise is malignant (wider W hurts). Fix: densify N_DIRS to 800-1600. Diagnostic W-sweep scores truth-EXACT cells -- oracle-leak, N=1.
